summary: Position-calibrated replication: with ZL3b's clock positions, zodiac labels at the same clock angle in the same ring agree across signs no more than labels shuffled within rings (0 exact, 9 near in 1,303; p 1.0 and 0.89), and still not when each page pair may rotate and reverse (17 exact, 78 near; p 0.20 and 0.54); planted fixed and rotating rosters of only two positions are both detected (p 0.003 and 0.005).
